FN-I35A166-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 517
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Rhett Marques
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 517 as introduced could increase receipts to the Underground Damage Prevention
Fund by an undetermined amount depenent on any grants, assessments, and civil penalties
collected by the Underground Damage Prevention Authority that otherwise would not be
deposited into the fund, absent this bill.
